authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 55 agni gives eastern āgi/āg and regional āgī fire. Selected āīg/aⁱg/aig retain the source placement of the high vowel before the velar, while Dang aghi retains aspiration notation. These are qualified regional agni-family matches; no source spelling correction or precise immediate Indo-Aryan donor is asserted. Exact response: āīg.
